title: The Secret of the Cemetery
subtitle: A Film Director, A Clue, and Grave Secrets
summary: When a flamboyant film director arrives with a mysterious car and an even more baffling story, Feluda is drawn into a labyrinth of intrigue surrounding an old cemetery. Witty banter and razor-sharp deduction propel this classic whodunit, where every clue leads deeper into a web of deception. Will Feluda unravel the cemetery’s secret before it’s too late?
